nodes.text: “Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a common but often overlooked respiratory virus. It can cause cold-like symptoms, bronchiolitis, or pneumonia, especially in young kids, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. Stay informed, stay safe! #HMPV
